title: Medical Interpreting ROI: Key Inputs & Scenarios
summary: Learn how healthcare administrators can measure medical interpreter ROI using supported encounters, time to interpretation.
body_markdown:
###


Medical interpreter ROI compares what an organization spends on language access with how effectively the program reaches patients and supports clinical communication.


###


Cost per successfully supported encounter is a useful starting metric because it connects spending with actual access.


###


Not by itself. Lower use can mean a better workflow, but it can also mean staff are skipping interpretation. Check whether access stayed stable or improved.


###


Track supported encounters, time to active interpretation, fallback use, short-interaction coverage, and patient-call coverage.


###


A quarterly review is often enough to identify changes in cost and access, with more frequent checks during a pilot or rollout.
